approval: Website-published facts, not owner-approved policy. Conflicts are held for staff review.

entries.answer: In-stock items usually arrive in about 10–15 business days after ordering. This is an estimate, so please check with our team if you need delivery by a particular date. Large furniture is delivered to the curb and needs a signature; assembly and packaging removal aren't included. Delivery costs and options depend on your address.
entries.reviewNote: General FAQ describes dispatch in 2–5 business days; this is not delivery. Canada coverage conflicts with US-only wording in terms. Do not promise Canadian duties-inclusive totals or excluded-region forwarding arrangements.

entries.answer: Thinking of returning an item? Please contact our team before sending it back. They'll need to check your purchase and confirm the return window, any fees and a return authorization number. To get started here, choose Order help below.
entries.reviewNote: 30 days from purchase versus receipt; 20% restocking and 3% administrative fees versus full pre-dispatch refund wording. Do not calculate a refund or reject a claim automatically.

entries.answer: Comfortel products in the US have a standard one-year limited warranty, subject to the policy's conditions and exclusions. If something has gone wrong, choose Product support below. Share the model, order number if available, and a description or photo of the issue so our team can review whether it's covered.
entries.reviewNote: US warranty page exists despite AU footer links. Its coverage wording conflicts with disclaimers in US terms; never decide a claim automatically.

entries.answer: Prices are in US dollars, and Comfortel supplies businesses and industry professionals. You can purchase through our website or sales team. Tracking details are emailed when your order ships. Need help with an existing purchase? Choose Order help below—I'll collect the details for a request to our team.
entries.reviewNote: Do not infer live inventory, final taxes, financing eligibility, deposit terms or order changes from static data.

entries.answer: If something arrived damaged or is missing, please contact our team as soon as possible. Keep the packaging and take photos of the item and any damage. Choose Product support below to share what happened and your order number, if available. Keep any videos handy in case the team needs them later.
entries.reviewNote: FAQ says 48 hours and requests video evidence; terms say two business days for shortages/rejection. Never deny a late report.

entries.answer: You can visit a showroom in Carlstadt, NJ; Katy, TX; or Richmond Hill, Ontario by appointment. Listed hours are Monday–Friday, 9 am–4 pm. Choose Sales / visit below to request a visit. Let us know the location and time you'd prefer, and wait for the team's confirmation before travelling.
entries.reviewNote: Contact page lists all three addresses. Do not infer slot availability or that a particular item is on display.

entries.answer: Business financing is available through Beneficial Capital, subject to their approval and terms. You can find the application link on our finance page below. For your security, use that application rather than sharing financial or identity documents here.
entries.reviewNote: Do not quote rates, guarantee approval or offer tax advice.

entries.answer: The right advice depends on the exact model. Choose Product support below and share the product name and what you'd like to check. Our team will need to confirm the relevant product guidance before advising on installation, cleaning, weight limits or certifications.
entries.reviewNote: Do not infer certifications or provide electrical/plumbing repair instructions from product photos or unrelated regional manuals.

entries.answer: You can reach our US customer service team at 646-204-2591 or info@comfortelfurniture.com. Prefer to start here? Choose an option below and I'll help you put together a request.
entries.reviewNote: Other pages list other sales/showroom numbers. Label this as the general FAQ contact, not the only company number.
